title: Vietnamese-Style Cha Buns
description: A flavorful and refreshing take on traditional Vietnamese street food, these cha buns are filled with grilled pork and topped with crunchy lettuce and creamy avocado.

ingredients.name: Cha Meat
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of meat you like, such as pork or beef

ingredients.name: Lettuce
ingredients.notes: Choose a crisp and crunchy lettuce for the best results

ingredients.name: Avocado
ingredients.notes: Mash the avocado for a creamy topping

ingredients.name: Bun
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade buns

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the cha meat into thin strips and season with soy sauce, sugar, and Worcestershire sauce (if using).
3. Grill the cha meat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the buns by grilling them for 1-2 minutes per side.
5. Assemble the buns by spreading a layer of hoisin sauce on the bottom bun, followed by a few pieces of the grilled cha meat.
6. Top with lettuce, avocado, and any other desired toppings.
